limits: All counts describe this exact source and actual jobs; no old c3b or 025 green is reused.
The Browser gate is an echo only; Site-search uses the Playwright runner for declared HTTP API tests, not a claim of browser interaction.
No formal Apple Native query budget, production served version, E2B publication/runtime refresh, production model run or PostHog ingestion is established here.
Successful job/post-job metadata and direct GHA service removal do not prove unlogged internal fixture destruction; custody conditional retention text remains explicit unknown.
No raw test stdout is suppressed because it includes expected errors, skipped conditions, cache warnings or deprecated-action warnings.
Node and Vitest/Python/Go/Playwright counts are reported separately; they are not summed into unique tests across overlapping jobs.
